confidence_notes: Food estimates use recent Rishikesh price ranges and a city price index with few contributors. Accommodation is a broad estimate for a backpacker and pilgrimage town. Alcohol is unevenly available, so cocktail and wine prices are less certain and are estimated relative to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Rishikesh-specific price references. Accommodation uses a broad estimate for a tourist town in northern India; no comparable city was used.
